title: devwork · continuity prompt: the one prompt that carries a task across sessions (factory logbook 133, 134, 140, 148)

description.description: one line that lets an agent decide whether to open this file. Preloaded for routing, so it carries the whole decision.

form.description: paragraph = a single pasteable block. bundle = a numbered directory where the numeric prefix IS the read order, so no prose list can drift from the directory.

cwd.description: absolute path the session starts from

reads.description: ordered absolute paths. Pointers, never inlined content.

verify.description: run before building anything. Proves the state this loader claims is real.

first_action.description: the literal next command or edit, not a description of it

done_when.description: falsifiable close condition for the stage this loader opens

locked.description: decisions the fresh session must not re-derive or re-litigate

prohibitions.description: targeted imperatives only. Never a non-goals catalogue.

expires_when.description: condition after which this loader is stale and must not be pasted

frozen_copies.description: for form=bundle. Files copied into the bundle, with the live source that wins on conflict.

disposable_when.description: for form=bundle. When the whole directory can be deleted.

focus.description: function 3: the one next step and the result it must produce

traps.description: function 4: the live error gotchas of the world; encuadre traps checks their freshness before work

snapshot.description: function 2: the ledger ids this session wrote, first-last; the body cites them, never retells them
